parameters.content:
## Get new building permits in your ZIP codes every week, by email and Slack

A permit is filed weeks before the work starts, which makes it one of the earliest leads a contractor, supplier or installer can get. Every Monday this workflow pulls the building permits a US city issued in the last 7 days in the ZIP codes you choose, and sends one digest: address, permit type, work description, declared value and contractor.

**Who's it for**
Roofers, solar installers, HVAC and pool companies, building suppliers, and anyone who sells to contractors or new owners.

**How it works**
1. A schedule trigger fires every Monday morning
2. A Set node holds the city, the ZIP codes, optional keywords and where to send the digest
3. The Apify node runs Building Permits API for the last 7 days
4. A Code node builds one digest: an HTML table for email and a short list for Slack
5. Gmail and Slack send it. Keep either one, or both.

**Setup**
1. Create an Apify account and add your API token to the Apify credential
2. Connect Gmail and/or Slack
3. In the Set node, pick the city, your ZIP codes, your email address and your Slack channel

**Cities with ZIP codes**
us-nyc-dob (New York City), us-la-building (Los Angeles), us-austin-building, us-seattle-building, us-dallas-building, us-cincinnati-building, us-montgomery-md-residential, us-montgomery-md-commercial and us-baton-rouge-building. Chicago, Orlando, New Orleans and Mesa publish no ZIP codes: empty the ZIP list and filter with keywords instead.

**Good to know**
$5 per 1,000 permits. The Set node asks for 100 permits at most and the Apify node stops a run at $0.50. No email is sent in a week without new permits. What each city publishes differs: Dallas rarely has values or contractors.
Actor: https://apify.com/gaelasao/planning-data-au-nz-fr

### 1. Schedule
Runs every Monday morning. Swap in a manual trigger while you test.

### 2. Area to watch
City source ID, five-digit ZIP codes, optional keywords such as solar or roof, and where to send the digest.

### 3. Permits
Runs Building Permits API on Apify for the 7 days up to yesterday. The run stops at $0.50 (node setting).

### 4. Digest
One item for the week: subject, HTML table and Slack text. Links go to the city permit page when it exists.

### 5. Send
Gmail and Slack both get the digest. Delete the one you do not use.
